title: Rust TimeProvider trait alignment
description: Ensure Rust TimeProvider trait (unix_time_us, has_gnss_fix, stratum) matches Zephyr time provider semantics. NoTimeProvider returns None/false/255.
close_reason: Already fixed - Rust TimeProvider trait correctly implements: unix_time_us() returns Option<u64> (None when unavailable), has_gnss_fix() returns bool (false when no fix), stratum() returns u8 with 0=best/255=unsynchronized (matching spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md). NoTimeProvider returns None/false/255 as expected.
